messages.content: Is there a limit on how many photos I can post in one set?
Honestly, I don't have a specific number documented for that - the material I have covers uploads generally but not a per-set limit. Worth checking your creator dashboard directly.
ok what about video length limits

That one actually is documented - individual videos are capped at 60 minutes. If you need longer, splitting into a series seems to be the common workaround, though that's not an official recommendation, just what I'd infer.
